SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID, EMPLOYEE_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DEPARTMENT_ID, JOB_ID, SALARY, ENTRANCE_DATE, STATUS, VERSION FROM EMPLOYEE
ORDER BY EMPLOYEE_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID, EMPLOYEE_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DEPARTMENT_ID, JOB_ID, SALARY, ENTRANCE_DATE, STATUS, VERSION FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMPLOYEE (EMPLOYEE_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DEPARTMENT_ID, JOB_ID, SALARY, ENTRANCE_DATE, STATUS, VERSION) VALUES (#{employeeCode}, #{employeeName}, #{departmentId}, #{jobId}, #{salary}, #{entranceDate}, #{status}, #{version})
mapper.update: UPDATE EMPLOYEE SET EMPLOYEE_CODE = #{employeeCode} WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId}
UPDATE EMPLOYEE SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId}
